column1: # The servers this engine's committed answers come from. default records the
# tapes and serves the catalog and review suites; parser judges
# mysql/parser/testdata/compat.tsv at the same mysql:8.0.46 release so a
# judge revision bump rejudges compat.tsv without touching the default-pinned
# tapes. Its grammar is sql/sql_yacc.yy at the source tag (sources.tsv). The
# other roles serve the review walk, which holds itself to the servers
# Bytebase meets: lctn1 is the same release started with
# lower_case_table_names=1, which is fixed when the server initializes, and
# parser judge revision 2 samples a real system variable (autocommit) for
# lvalue_variable so SET near-misses parse past the 1193 variable lookup, and
# re-asks 1128 (ER_FUNCTION_NOT_DEFINED) from WITH PARSER using MySQL's
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag, judge revision
